title: Senior Analyst | Investment Analytics
job_description:
Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Investment, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Actual Science, Financial Engineering, Data Analytics or related field recognized by the Government of Malaysia. Professional certifications such as Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or Data Analytics credentials are an added advantage. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in investment analytics, performance reporting, financial data analysis, or portfolio management within asset management, fund management, or financial institutions. Malaysian citizen. Obtain a pass in Bahasa Melayu, including an oral test in Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) level or equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Strong understanding of investment instruments (e.g., equities, fixed income, private markets, derivatives), financial markets, portfolio performance metrics, risk and valuation concepts. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), with experience in data visualization and automated reporting. Familiarity with VBA, SQL, Python, or other data tools is an advantage. Strong ability to analyze complex data, identify issues, and develop effective solutions with keen attention to detail. Proactive and self-motivated, with strong discipline and adaptability to new technologies. Able to perform effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Capable of managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Demonstrate ability to plan, organize, and execute tasks effectively, including setting clear timelines and managing resources efficiently. Collaborative team player with a positive attitude. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Melayu.

Investment Data Analytics Conduct daily and periodic portfolio performance reviews and prepare analytical reports on portfolio performance and investment indicators. Design, define and maintain interactive dashboard layouts and reporting specifications, ensuring alignment with business needs and user experience standards. Ensure analytics initiatives align with organizational investment objectives and risk management strategies. Analyze financial data, market trends, and economic indicators to provide actionable insights for investment decisions. Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, internal frameworks, and financial reporting standards. Validate and manage data accuracy and integrity from internal systems and external sources. Projects and Process improvement Partner with the Investment Departments and Digital Technology Departments to enhance analytics processes and reporting automation. Coordinate investment analytics projects to ensure timely and high-quality delivery. Drive initiatives for process optimization, automation, and implementation of best practices in investment operations.
